# Memory policy

Use `vibebug memory context`; never preload the index. The default pack is capped at about 1,400 tokens, five entries, and two episodes. Retrieval prefers verified project/module/decision knowledge over issue history. Episodes are compact audit history, not general rules. Durable memory requires a concise reusable claim, an explicit scope, changed paths, and test/code evidence. Current code wins over memory. Conflicts and modified entries are proposed under runtime pending updates, never silently overwritten. Never store secrets, personal data, screenshots, large logs, prompts, or reasoning traces.
